content: Starter plan: 39 dollars per month. Pro plan: 99 dollars per month. Enterprise: custom pricing, unlimited seats during the Sept 2026 promo, reverting to per-seat pricing above 50 users after Sept 30.
Section 4: Remote work is permitted up to 4 days per week with manager approval for exceptions. Section 7: Expense reimbursement must be filed within 30 days of purchase.
The platform uses a FastAPI backend, LangGraph for agent orchestration, and Pinecone for vector search. The rate limiter deployed in June reduced timeout errors significantly.
Acme security program includes SOC 2 Type II certification, mandatory two-factor authentication, full-disk encryption on all endpoints, and quarterly penetration testing by a third party.

On August 22 2026, a bad load balancer config caused elevated API error rates for 47 minutes. Root cause: missing pre-deploy validation. Remediation: added automated config linting to the deploy pipeline.
Primary brand color is Acme Blue. Logo must maintain minimum clear space equal to the height of the logomark. Do not stretch, recolor, or rotate the logo.
Standard vendor contract template includes a 30-day termination clause, data processing addendum, and standard liability cap of 12 months of fees paid.
New enterprise customers are assigned a dedicated onboarding specialist for the first 90 days. Kickoff call must happen within 5 business days of contract signature.
